newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia tenders $59 million in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia tenders $59 million in T-bills.

text.p: The central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) on Thursday tendered for sale treasury bills valued at 390 million birr ($59 million).
The bills are for the 28-day, 91-day and 182-day categories and are to be issued on April 9, 1997.
The amounts tendered were 190 million birr for 28-day bills maturing on May 7, 150 million birr for 91-day bills maturing on July 9 and 50 million birr for 182-day bill maturing on October 8.
